title: The Yakyuuken Special: Kon'ya wa 12-kaisen!!
native_title: ザ・野球拳・スペシャル ～今夜は１２回戦！！～
overview: The Yakyuuken Special is an updated port of a 3DO striptease game of the same name. As before, the player visits various models who challenge the player to a game of janken (rock-paper-scissors), doing a dance before making their move. Each time the player wins, the opponent removes an article of clothing, leaving her fully nude after five rounds. This version includes a total of twelve young ladies to challenge: the same eight from the original 3DO release, plus four new girls exclusive to this Saturn version.
